title: Refund endpoint with idempotency key reservation
name: Charge refund service

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code records outcomes against idempotency keys? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client retries a refund with the same key while the first request is still waiting on the gateway. What does the retry receive?
choices: The 201 from the first request once it completes

questions.prompt: A merchant reuses key K, which earlier refunded 500 cents on charge ch_1, to request a 700-cent refund on ch_1. What happens?
choices: The original 201 for 500 cents is replayed

questions.prompt: The request asks to refund more than the remaining refundable amount. Which statement about a retry with the same key and body is correct?
choices: The retry re-checks the charge and may succeed if another refund was reversed
The retry gets 409 because the key stays in_progress
The first request throws and releases the key, so the retry runs fresh
The retry replays the stored 422 invalid_refund_amount
